theorems.name_zh: 保护精度下的一位线性提升
theorems.statement: All next lifts of a seed at action depth m and frame depth m+C are exactly solutions to the finite-field linear system in section 1.
theorems.assumptions_and_boundary: Finite nonsingular rational matrices normalized p-primitive; fixed atom matching, unit frame and unit scalars; m>=1.

theorems.name_zh: 仿射修复族与双重障碍
theorems.statement: A compatible next layer has p^d unique normalized frame lifts; otherwise yD=0, yr!=0 proves no lift. The obstruction class is independent of section choice.
theorems.assumptions_and_boundary: Same fixed seed and matching as GL-001; finite-field exact arithmetic.

theorems.name_zh: 共同修复不由分别可修推出
theorems.statement: The displayed two actions each admit four one-digit frame repairs, while their simultaneous system has none.
theorems.assumptions_and_boundary: The explicit p=2 example; joint frame variable must remain shared.

theorems.name_zh: 项目交换的有限精度寿命
theorems.statement: For A=diag(1,d) and S congruent to swap modulo p, a projective commutation solution modulo p^m exists iff d^2=1 modulo p^m.
theorems.assumptions_and_boundary: d is a p-adic unit. Repeated block X6 extension as proved; precision is not time.

theorems.name_zh: 提升失效的真实首达见证
theorems.statement: The explicit X6 path has endpoint carry spread 3 versus 5 after a common tail (running peaks 4 versus 5); at threshold 5 and equal branch weights, first hit at tick 3 has probability 1/2.
theorems.assumptions_and_boundary: Displayed integer matrices, fixed arrow-boundary observation, p=2.

theorems.name_zh: 固定对应的完备逐层搜索与BRC接入
theorems.statement: Complete low-level seeds and exhaustive uncapped affine lifting give complete higher fixed-matching seeds. Rechecking inherited weighted-row certificates licenses existing peak quotient tools.
theorems.assumptions_and_boundary: Completeness only within provided seed/matching/embedding family; no global GL6 or aggregate-mass stabilizer claim.
